dos: Wire Stripe Connect and hold for 30 consecutive days of clean cohort payback / take rate / GMV before opening any pitch (your own standing rule — non-negotiable).
Quote GMV in the deck, not MRR or ARR. If a number goes on a slide, trace it to a Stripe charge total or a DB query with a labeled date range.
Walk through existing SAFEs and founder instruments before finalizing the dilution stack — 20% assumes a clean $2M/$10M post; prior instruments push actual founder dilution higher.
Clear the P0 security queue (IDOR, password-hash leak, payout guard) BEFORE opening a data room. A 21-day-old auth bug on payment methods will surface in tech diligence.
In parallel now (allowed pre-gate): build the deck, 3-year cash-flow model, cap-table walk, per-host/per-trip unit econ, insurance/liability stack, data room, and warm-intro map.
donts: Do not put point-estimate CAC or LTV in materials pre-Stripe Connect + Google Ads integration.
Do not put a precise ARR/MRR figure on a slide you cannot trace to Stripe.
Do not open pitch meetings or send warm intros until BOTH gates flip (Stripe live + 30 days clean metrics). One credible unsolicited institutional term sheet is the only exception.
Do not stretch the ask past $2M without a warm Tier-1 lead pulling you up, and do not model cap above $12M on AI-hype tailwinds.

dimensions.verdict: 600 hosts live across CA/NV/TX/AZ/FL with ~$100K/mo GMV in the last confirmed snapshot is a real seed-stage story. What's missing is a POST-Stripe-Connect view showing the number is stable and trending, not a mid-May reference point. Fix by pulling live weekly GMV + host-count trends off Stripe once it's wired.
dimensions.source_ref: memory: Upcar operating snapshot (mid-May baseline, ~600 hosts / $100K mo GMV / 5 states)

dimensions.verdict: You have NO cohort payback in the brain. Live host retention and repeat-booking cohorts are blocked on Stripe Connect (the DB can't aggregate; Stripe is the authoritative path). Every seed investor asks for a repeat-cohort chart on the first call. Do not fabricate one. Wire Stripe, build the chart, then pitch.
dimensions.source_ref: memory: Host count measurement — Stripe dependency

dimensions.verdict: Take rate (14.1%) is defensible from the codebase. GMV is defensible from the mid-May DB snapshot. Anything downstream of those (payback, LTV, CAC, live MRR/ARR) is currently an estimate. Your own standing rule bans point-estimate CAC/LTV in materials until Stripe Connect + Google Ads are live. Hold to it — a metric you cannot defend in the room burns credibility for the whole round.
dimensions.source_ref: memory: Series A deck content rule: no CAC/LTV estimates pre-Stripe Connect + No fabricated metrics in decks

dimensions.verdict: Real, small, pre-Stripe. The ~$1.2M ARR figure floating in recent notes is a derived estimate off GMV and take rate, not a Stripe-verified number. Your own rule says quote GMV in the deck (~$100K/mo mid-May), never MRR or ARR — MRR implies subscription revenue and confuses marketplace investors at your stage. Do not put a precise ARR figure on a slide until Stripe verifies it.
dimensions.source_ref: memory: Deck metric quote GMV not MRR + Key metrics ~$23K/week GMV, 14.1% take rate

dimensions.verdict: The wedge is sharp and timely: Turo's Jan 2026 restructure + Getaround's US exit + Upcar's 90%+ host payout create a rare window on the host side of P2P mobility. Family-office framing (asset-light, cash-flow, long-hold, not a power-law growth bet) is the right posture for the buyer you're targeting. This is the strongest lever you have — lead every conversation with it.
dimensions.source_ref: memory: Pre-seed round preparation in progress + Family office pitch positioning

dimensions.verdict: Nothing in the brain confirms the deck, 3-year cash-flow model, cap-table walk (with prior SAFEs), unit-economics-per-host-and-per-trip, insurance/liability stack, or data room are built. Family offices ask for all of these on the first call. Second gap: your live P0 IDOR on getPaymentInfo has been unpatched 21 days — any tech-diligence call surfaces it and it will spook a security-minded FO. Build the pre-gate materials in parallel now AND clear the P0 queue before you open a diligence room.
dimensions.source_ref: memory: Family office pitch positioning + pm-run 2026-07-30 P0 IDOR queue

round_design_snapshot.verdict: Raise $2M at a $10M post cap. That is the right shape for where you are. You are at ~$1.2M ARR run-rate on ~$100K/mo GMV with 14.1% guest take + 25% host take, roughly $25 to $39K/mo blended take. The Series A revenue floor is $2.5M to $3M net ARR, which for you means getting GMV to $25M to $31M/year (roughly 2 to 2.5x from here). $2M at your current shape funds 18 to 24 months of building to that bar without over-diluting. Push the cap to $12M ONLY if a warm Tier-1 lead bids you up. Accept $8M cleanly for the right lead. Do NOT stretch to $3M+ ask without a lead pulling you there, and do NOT model above $12M off AI-hype tailwinds. Two things to know: (1) your last confirmed cash was $120K on May 26 at $15K/mo burn (~8mo runway then, likely ~$80 to $90K and ~5 to 6 months now), so timing pressure is real and the round needs to close inside ~4 months, not drift. (2) The standing gate holds: do not open the pitch until Stripe Connect is wired live AND you have 30 days of clean post-fix metrics. Sourcing the investor list is fine now, pitching is not.
